<?php

#[CoversClass(className: __REPOSITORY_CLASS__::class)]
final class __REPOSITORY_CLASS__IntegrationTest extends KernelTestCase
{
  private EntityManagerInterface $entityManager;

  private __REPOSITORY_CLASS__ $repository;

  protected function setUp(): void
  {
    self::bootKernel();
    $container = static::getContainer();

    /** @var EntityManagerInterface $entityManager */
    $entityManager = $container->get('__ENTITY_MANAGER_SERVICE__');
    $this->entityManager = $entityManager;

    $this->repository = new __REPOSITORY_CLASS__(
      entityManager: $this->entityManager,
      __REPOSITORY_CONSTRUCTOR_ARGUMENTS__
    );
  }

  protected function tearDown(): void
  {
    parent::tearDown();
    $this->entityManager->close();
  }

  #[Test]
  public function test__TEST_NAME__(): void
  {
    __SETUP_RECORDS__

    __EXERCISE_REPOSITORY__

    __ASSERTIONS__
  }
